phuṭṭho.g: ye te kuṭṭhādayo pañca ābādhā ussannā, tehi phuṭṭho adhibhūto na pabbājetabbo.
yathā bālo, dhīropi tatheva maraṇaphassena phuṭṭho, aphuṭṭho nāma natthi, ayaṁ pana viseso.
yehi kāraṇabhūtehi āyatanehi uppannena phassena phuṭṭho.
ārammaṇaṁ phusantena viya uppannena sukhavedaniyena, dukkhavedaniyena ca phassena phuṭṭho.
ātaṅkaphasso vuccati rogaphasso, rogaphassena phuṭṭho pareto samohito samannāgato assa.
so tehi ātaṅkādīhi anekehi ākārehi phuṭṭho samānopi.

upanissayabhūtassa kusalakammassa phalabhūtena lokuttaramaggena, lokuttarakammasseva vā phalena vimuttisukhena phuṭṭho.
so tehi ātaṅkādīhi anekehi ākārehi phuṭṭho samāno.
